meta.title: Scholarships Dataset: Indian Universities, Coaching Centres, Abroad Programs & Hackathon Grants
meta.disclaimer: Amounts, deadlines, and eligibility change frequently. Always verify on the official website before applying/building features around this data.
meta.currency_note: INR = Indian Rupees, USD = US Dollars, GBP = British Pounds, EUR = Euros

indian_universities.name: Ashoka University
indian_universities.scholarship_program: Achievers' Merit Scholarship & Special Merit Scholarship
indian_universities.eligibility: 98+ percentile in JEE Mains, top 2000 in IISER IAT, top 100 in CMI entrance, or INO Training Camp qualifiers

indian_universities.name: Chandigarh University
indian_universities.scholarship_amount: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver (also region-specific schemes, e.g. Ladakh scholarship pool worth INR 1.5 Crore)
indian_universities.eligibility: 9.0+ CGPA, CUET/CUCET merit rank, or regional criteria

indian_universities.name: Geeta University
indian_universities.scholarship_amount: Up to 100% scholarship (pool worth INR 24 Crore)
indian_universities.eligibility: Performance in Geeta University Talent Search (GUTS) exam

indian_universities.name: Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) / NITs
indian_universities.scholarship_program: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSSS) / Institute Merit-cum-Means
indian_universities.scholarship_amount: Full tuition waiver + maintenance allowance for income-eligible students
indian_universities.eligibility: Admission via JEE + family income and merit criteria

indian_universities.name: IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University)
indian_universities.scholarship_program: Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Doctoral Studies (for international students)

indian_universities.name: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology
Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
indian_universities.scholarship_amount: Up to INR 2,00,000 over the course duration
indian_universities.eligibility: Merit + household income cutoff up to INR 15 Lakhs annually

indian_coaching_centres.name: Allen Career Institute
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_test: ALLEN Scholarship-cum-Admission Test (ASAT), TALLENTEX, ALLEN Champ
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_amount: Up to 90-100% fee waiver for top scorers (85%+ in ASAT typically qualifies)
indian_coaching_centres.eligibility: Classes 6-12 / droppers; based on test score or Olympiad/NTSE credentials

indian_coaching_centres.name: Aakash Educational Services (AESL)
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_test: Admission Cum Scholarship Test (ACST/iACST), Aakash National Talent Hunt Exam (ANTHE)
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_amount: Up to 100% fee waiver on classroom courses
indian_coaching_centres.eligibility: Classes 7-12 students, based on test percentile

indian_coaching_centres.name: FIITJEE
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_amount: Fee reductions up to 50% or more for top rankers

indian_coaching_centres.name: Resonance
indian_coaching_centres.focus: JEE, NEET, Olympiads, NTSE, KVPY, BITSAT
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_amount: Up to 100% scholarship on classroom programs
indian_coaching_centres.eligibility: Classes 5-12, based on academic standing and test score

indian_coaching_centres.name: Physics Wallah (PW)
indian_coaching_centres.scholarship_amount: Up to 100% scholarship; base fees already low (from ~INR 20,000/year)

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Chevening Scholarship
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, return economy airfare, arrival/departure allowance, visa costs
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: 2+ years work experience, leadership potential, return-to-home-country commitment

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Commonwealth Scholarship (Master's/PhD)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.funded_by: UK Government via Commonwealth Scholarship Commission
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, airfare, monthly living allowance, thesis/study grants
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Indian citizens, development-relevant subjects, preference for financially disadvantaged applicants, nominated via India's Ministry of Education
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.typical_application_window: Deadline typically end of January / May depending on category

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: DAAD Scholarships
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.degree_level: Master's, PhD, Research stays (~19 programs for Indian applicants)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Monthly stipend, travel allowance, health insurance, tuition support (most German public universities have no/low tuition)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Varies by program; generally strong academic record and relevant field

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Degree (EMJMD)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, monthly stipend (~EUR 1,000), travel and installation costs, insurance
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Open globally; competitive, strong academic profile

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: MEXT Scholarship (Monbukagakusho)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, monthly stipend, round-trip airfare
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Age limits apply, strong academic record, via Indian embassy application

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowship
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, living stipend, round-trip airfare, health insurance
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.typical_application_window: Deadlines vary by category; APEX Fellowship around July

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Full tuition, living costs, airfare, academic expenses
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Outstanding academic record, admission to Cambridge required first

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarship
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.country: USA / UK / Europe (for Indian students going abroad)
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.coverage: Up to USD 100,000 covering tuition, living expenses, and travel
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Indian citizens under 30, admission to a top-ranked university abroad

abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.name: Rhodes Scholarship
abroad_scholarships_covering_travel.eligibility: Exceptional academic and leadership record, age limits apply

hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.name: Smart India Hackathon (SIH)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.prize_structure: INR 1,00,000 per winning problem statement (varies by cycle)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.travel_support: Finalist teams travel to nodal/grand finale centres; travel and stay typically arranged/supported by host institutions
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.eligibility: Students enrolled in Indian colleges/universities, teams of ~6 with mentors

hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.name: MLH Fellowship & Member Event Scholarships
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.country: Global (includes India-based participants at global/virtual hackathons)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.prize_structure: Varies by event; MLH Fellowship offers a paid, structured program (not a cash prize)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.travel_support: Select organizer/participant travel reimbursements at MLH Member Events (varies per event/year)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.eligibility: Students, varies by specific fellowship track (open source, production engineering, etc.)

hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.name: Independent/Sponsor-funded Indian Hackathons (e.g., university & startup-hosted events)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.prize_structure: Ranges widely, e.g. INR 35,000 to INR 12.9 Lakh+ prize pools depending on scale/sponsor
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.travel_support: Case-by-case; larger/national-level events sometimes cover finalist travel and accommodation
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.eligibility: Typically open to undergraduate/graduate students; varies per event

hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.name: Global Online Hackathons with Cash Prizes (e.g., Devpost-hosted, corporate-sponsored)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.organizer: Various tech companies and platforms (e.g., Google Cloud, Microsoft-affiliated events)
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.prize_structure: USD 300 to USD 25,000+ depending on sponsor and scale
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.travel_support: Rare for fully-online events; some finals (e.g., in-person buildathons) fly in top teams
hackathon_related_scholarships_and_trave.eligibility: Varies; often open globally to students and early-career developers
